about: The Postcommunion of the formulary “Visitation of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, we have received the long-desired sacraments of this annual feast. Grant, we beseech You, that they may provide remedies for our earthly life and for life everlasting. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
